info.title: OpenWrench Supplier API
info.description:
External REST API for OpenWrench suppliers (service providers).

## Authentication
Every request must carry a supplier API key in the `X-API-KEY` header. The key resolves to a supplier contact; all reads and writes are tenant-scoped to that contact's supplier facility/company. Missing or invalid keys are answered with 401.

## Rate limiting
10 requests per 20-second window per API key. Requests beyond that are answered with 429 and the standard error envelope. (A few endpoints, noted in their descriptions, are not rate-limited.)

## Response envelope
Single entity: `{"type": "<EntityName>", "data": {...}, "status": "ok"}`. Lists: `{"type": "<EntityName>", "data": [...], "count": <total>, "status": "ok"}`. count_by endpoints return the integer count in `data`. The `type` label is hard-coded on some endpoints (e.g. "WorkOrderNotes", "pingpong") and derived via Scala reflection on generic CRUD endpoints, where it may appear as the fully qualified server class name - treat it as informational. Errors: `{"message": "...", "type": "<ExceptionType>", "status": "error", "traceId": "..."}` with HTTP 400 (bad input, and also permission-denied reads/writes), 401 (missing/invalid key), 404 (not found), 429 (rate limit).

## Pagination
List endpoints accept `offset`, `limit` (default 10, max 25 - the supplier locations list caps at 10), `sort_by` and `order` (`asc`|`desc`), plus entity-specific query-string filters on indexed columns.

## Data masking
For third-party suppliers (keys whose supplier company is not a buyer's internal service team), work order, location and invoice responses are masked: buyer-private fields are blanked before the response is returned.

## Date formats
Date-time fields serialize as strings in one of two shapes depending on the underlying type: ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. `2026-08-14T13:05:22.000-07:00`) for most timestamps, or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.S` (space-separated, no offset) for database timestamp fields. Plain dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`. When sending date-times, ISO 8601 is accepted.

## Required headers
Every request must carry BOTH `X-API-KEY` (your API key) and `OW-KEY` (the OpenWrench shared secret issued with it). Requests missing either return 401.

get.description: Verifies the supplier API key. Returns {"type":"pingpong","data":"pong","status":"ok"}. Note: this endpoint is authenticated but NOT rate-limited.

get.summary: List buyer companies related to the supplier
get.description: Returns the buyer companies that have a buyer-supplier relationship with the API key's supplier. No pagination or filter parameters are honoured (the full tenant-scoped set is returned); each company's buyerCompanySettings is stripped (null).

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

get.description: Counts locations visible to the supplier key. Accepts the same query-string filters as the list endpoint. Additional entity-specific query-string filters (indexed column names) are passed through to the data layer; tenant-security filters restricting results to the API key's supplier facility/company are always applied server-side and cannot be overridden.

get.description: Lists locations visible to the supplier key. NOTE: on this endpoint the page size is capped at 10 (a larger limit is silently reduced to 10). Additional entity-specific query-string filters (indexed column names) are passed through to the data layer; tenant-security filters restricting results to the API key's supplier facility/company are always applied server-side and cannot be overridden.

post.summary: Create a work order
post.description: Creates a supplier-initiated work order. Requires the API key's contact to belong to a supplier facility. locationId is required; problemTypeId and woPriorityId are defaulted from the location's buyer company when omitted. Returns the created work order.

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

locationId.description: REQUIRED. The buyer location the work order is for; also determines the server-set buyerFacilityId and buyerCompanyId.

problemTypeId.description: Optional; when omitted the first leaf problem type of the location's buyer company is used. Must reference an existing problem type.

woPriorityId.description: Optional; when omitted a default priority for the buyer company is chosen (preference order 3,4,5,2,1, following linkedTo mappings).

id.description: Existing work order id (update semantics); the referenced work order must exist.

status.description: Work-order status name; when omitted, the initial status is derived from the buyer company's configuration (typically Unassigned/PendingApproval). Invalid names are rejected.

assetId.description: Must reference an existing asset; its areaId is inherited when areaId is not given

parts.description: Part ids (mapped to the work order's partIds)

walkThroughId.description: Must be set together with siteSurveyTaskTitleId

siteSurveyTaskTitleId.description: Must be set together with walkThroughId

schema.description: Work-order create payload (verified against the shared work-order constructor). createdBy, supplierFacilityId, buyerFacilityId and buyerCompanyId are always overwritten server-side from the API key and the location - caller-supplied values for them are ignored. Unknown fields are ignored.

get.description: Lists work orders visible to the supplier key (served from a read replica). Additional entity-specific query-string filters (indexed column names) are passed through to the data layer; tenant-security filters restricting results to the API key's supplier facility/company are always applied server-side and cannot be overridden.

patch.summary: Append supplier attachments to a work order
patch.description: Appends the given file references to the work order's supplierAttachments. Only the supplierAttachments field is read from the body; existing attachments are preserved.

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

supplierAttachments.description: File references (as returned by the file upload endpoint), required

patch.summary: Append a note to a work order
patch.description: Appends a note to the work order's buyer-supplier note thread and sends note notifications. Returns the updated work order.

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

schema.description: Verified payload: the work order id plus a single optional note object. note.text and note.noteAddedBy are the meaningful fields; noteAddedAt is overwritten with the server's current time, and the author's email is added to the work order's supplier subscriber list.

patch.summary: Append photo notes to a work order in bulk
patch.description: Appends up to 25 photo-only notes to the work order's buyer-supplier note thread in one call and sends a single grouped notification instead of one notification per photo. Each note must carry a photo URL and no other content (empty text, no video, audio, otherFile, or elements), and the same photo URL cannot appear twice in one request. Returns the updated work order.

400.description: Validation failure: notes is empty, has more than 25 entries, contains a note that is not photo-only, repeats a photo URL, or the payload could not be parsed

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

notes.description: Photo-only notes to append, in the order they should appear on the thread. Each entry must set photo and leave every other content field empty; photo URLs must be unique within the request.

schema.description: The work order id plus 1-25 photo-only notes. Every note's noteAddedBy is set to the calling contact and noteAddedAt is overwritten with the server's current time; the author's email is added to the work order's supplier subscriber list.

get.description: Returns the work order's buyer-supplier notes and marks them read for the calling contact (read receipts updated). Envelope type is "WorkOrderNotes". A denied read returns an empty list rather than an error.

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

post.summary: Work order status update: confirm
post.description: Sets the work order status to ConfirmedByServiceProvider and sends note notifications. A work order already in a completed/closed display status cannot be accepted (400). Returns the updated work order.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

schema.description: Verified payload: the work order id plus a single optional note object appended to the work order's notes with the status change.

post.summary: Work order status update: decline
post.description: Declines the work order as the supplier. Only contacts of the work order's assigned supplier facility may decline. The work order is unassigned/reassigned via the supplier-change flow (status returns to PendingApproval or a private-network supplier is auto-picked), the optional note's text is recorded as the decline reason, and buyer-facing notification copy reflects the decline. Returns the updated work order.

post.summary: Service call status update: tech scheduled
post.description: Creates/updates a service call assigning technician(s). The work order status becomes TechScheduled when serviceScheduledAt is present in the body, otherwise TechAssigned. On success the ASSOCIATED WORK ORDER (not the service call) is returned with its status updated. When the resulting status is WorkReviewedAndCompleted, invoice auto-publishing rules may run. For third-party suppliers whose buyer company has autoApproveWorkOrdersCompletedByThirdParty enabled, a WaitingForReview outcome is auto-promoted to WorkReviewedAndCompleted.

checkInTime.description: Defaults to now when checkInStatus is set without a time

checkOutTime.description: Defaults to now when checkOutStatus is set without a time

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Filter to one WrenchMode schedule. When present, pagination is DISABLED and the schedule's full event timeline is returned.

parameters.name: eventTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of event types. Valid values: began_trip, trip_paused, trip_resumed, arrived, trip_cancelled, drive_note, started_work, ended_work, location_started, location_paused, location_resumed, location_ended. Unknown values are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: supplierEmails
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of technician emails, matched case-insensitively. (Only the plural key is exposed.)

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Window start, yyyy-MM-dd. Malformed dates are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Window end, yyyy-MM-dd. Malformed dates are rejected with 400.

get.description: Returns the per-technician drive/work/total time rollup for the API key's supplier facility over the given window. The window may span at most 1 month; both dates are yyyy-MM-dd. Requires the key's contact to belong to a supplier facility (401 otherwise).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

parameters.name: supervisorEmail
parameters.description: Optional: restrict the rollup to technicians under this supervisor

post.summary: Create (submit) a proposal
post.description: Creates a proposal for a work order. Not available to internal-service-team keys (their supplier company is private to a buyer). The proposal is created directly in "pending" status under the API key's supplier facility.

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

workOrderId.description: REQUIRED. Work order the proposal is for; must exist. locationId, buyerFacilityId and buyerCompanyId are derived from it.

totalAfterTax.description: REQUIRED. Must parse as a number.

taxRate.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

tax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

totalBeforeTax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

laborTaxRate.description: Must parse as a number if present

laborTax.description: Must parse as a number if present

laborTotalBeforeTax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

materialTotalBeforeTax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

travelTotalBeforeTax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

freightTotalBeforeTax.description: Defaults to "0"; must parse as a number

miscLineItems.description: Each amount must parse as a number

incurredCostLineItems.description: Each amount must parse as a number

requestForProposalId.description: Defaults to the work order's RFP when omitted

schema.description: Proposal create payload (verified against the shared proposal constructor). status is always forced to "pending" and supplierFacilityId to the API key's facility; caller values for them are ignored. Monetary values are strings and are validated as parseable numbers - laborLineItems require numeric hourlyRate and amount, materialLineItems numeric quantity, amount and unitPrice. Unknown fields are ignored.

post.summary: Create a draft invoice

406.description: Invoice validation failed (IllegalArgumentException from the invoice service)

400.description: Bad input, validation failure, or the API key's contact could not be resolved

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests per 20-second window)

workOrderId.description: REQUIRED. Work order the invoice bills; must exist. locationId, buyerFacilityId, buyerCompanyId, spendCategoryId and problemTypeId are derived from it.

poNumber.description: Defaults to the work order's poNumber

invoiceTaxRate.description: Must parse as a number if present (all monetary strings below likewise)

miscLineItems.description: Each amount must parse as a number

taxLineItems.description: Validated against the invoice currency's allowed tax types (currently only CAD: GST/HST/PST); rejected otherwise

invoicePDFLink.description: Must be a valid URL; becomes the single invoicePDFs entry

invoicePDFWatermarkedLink.description: Must be a valid URL; becomes the single invoicePDFsWatermarked entry

post.summary: Purchase order webhook (third-party integrations)

Depending on status: approved/error append a note to the PO; rejected cancels the PO; completed marks it ordered; shipping_update appends a shipping note and, when message.shipment_delivery_date is present, auto-creates receipts for all non-received line items. Every request/response is audited. Response shape varies by branch (note-append result, PO envelope, or receipt list).

post.summary: Provision a supplier user
post.description: Creates a supplier contact (and, when a password is given, a login-enabled user account) under the API key's supplier company. Rules: roles must be non-empty and may NOT include admin/super-admin roles (403); the target facility (facilityId, defaulting to the key's own facility) must belong to the same supplier company (403); an existing account or contact for the email is a 400 conflict. SUPPLIER_TECH roles additionally get a FieldTech record. Without a password, a sign-up invitation email is sent; with one, the account is created active (optionally with passwordResetRequired). Admin-granting shortcuts: any admin role would force hasAccessToAllLocations, but admin roles are rejected here.
